title: Feel templates: liquid, neuro, jump-up, electro house, techno, trance, big room
doc: Seven feel templates on template v1 (tools/concepts/families/feels.json): the same 25 atom names as the phonk feels, so one atoms.import line picks a feel. Grooves are compositions of the standard presets: liquid groove-swing(54) | groove-human(2.5, 0.15), tight groove-human(0.5, 0.05), jump groove-swing(52) | groove-push(-2) | groove-human(1, 0.12), drive groove-human(0.8, 0.08), house groove-swing(56) | groove-human(1, 0.1).

section.title: DnB, electro, house / techno / trance: kits, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/dnb-electro (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 8-11, sources in docs/DNB_ELECTRO_REFERENCES.md). F minor throughout, one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps. Components are racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md; per-role classes reese, neuro, break, gate) and pattern atoms (dnb. drum-and-bass, el. electro, hs. house / techno / trance / big room, tn. tension and release); forms are gate atoms (dnb.intro .. dnb.outro on a 128-bar DnB form, el.* and hs.* on 8-bar sections, hs.map* on a 160-bar club map of 32-bar blocks); breaks are synthesised and chopped by re-sequencing the 16 slices of a bar (.bite(16, atoms.dnb.chops)); sidechain is first-class (kickPump moves the superdough duck onto the bass, chord and pad orbits; kickDuck wires a gain to kick:env). Seven feel templates (feel-liquid, -neuro, -jumpup, -electrohouse, -techno, -trance, -bigroom) fill the same slots as the phonk feels; their grooves are compositions of the standard presets (groove-swing | groove-push | groove-human with the voice seed).

liquid.title: Liquid DnB
liquid.doc: rolling two-step with ghost notes behind the beat, shaker, held sub, liquid pad and vocal chops

neuro.title: Neurofunk
neuro.doc: machine-tight two-step, rolling ghosts, 8th hats and a 16th neuro riff (add a sub lane on atoms.feel.bass with dnbSub)

jumpup.title: Jump-up
jumpup.doc: bouncy two-step pushed slightly forward, a wobble bass with octave jumps

electrohouse.title: Electro house
electrohouse.doc: four-on-the-floor, offbeat hat, filtered saw bass and supersaw stabs on the offbeats

techno.title: Driving techno
techno.doc: four-on-the-floor, offbeat ride, 16th hats with accents, rolling bass in the kick's gaps

trance.title: Uplifting trance
trance.doc: four-on-the-floor, offbeat bass, pluck arp and trance-gated supersaw chords

bigroom.title: Big room
bigroom.doc: stripped drop: a big kick, a clap, an offbeat hat and one lead motif

syntax.title: Pick a DnB / EDM feel (one import line)
syntax.code:
setcpm(174/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:feel-liquid", { as: "feel" })   // or feel-neuro, -jumpup, -electrohouse, -techno, -trance, -bigroom (set the tempo too)
hooks.bind("kick", atoms.feel.kickRack)
hooks.bind("snare", atoms.feel.snareRack)
hooks.bind("perc", atoms.feel.percRack)
hooks.bind("hats", atoms.feel.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("top", atoms.feel.topRack)
hooks.bind("bass", atoms.feel.bassRack)
hooks.bind("harmony", atoms.feel.harmonyRack)
hooks.bind("fx", atoms.feel.fxRack)
kick: s(atoms.feel.kick).velocity(atoms.feel.kickVel).use("kick", { mode: "swap" })
snare: s(atoms.feel.snare).velocity(atoms.feel.snareVel).use("snare", { mode: "swap" })
perc: s(atoms.feel.perc).velocity(atoms.feel.percVel).use("perc", { mode: "swap" })
hats: s(atoms.feel.hats).velocity(atoms.feel.hatsVel).use("hats", { mode: "swap" })
top: note(atoms.feel.top).velocity(atoms.feel.topVel).use("top", { mode: "swap" })
bass: note(atoms.feel.bass).velocity(atoms.feel.bassVel).use("bass", { mode: "swap" })
harmony: note(atoms.feel.harmony).velocity(atoms.feel.harmonyVel).use("harmony", { mode: "swap" })
fx: s(atoms.feel.fx).velocity(atoms.feel.fxVel).use("fx", { mode: "swap" })

syntax.title: Feel switch: liquid to neuro at bar 3, sub layer kept
syntax.code:
setcpm(174/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:feel-liquid", { as: "a" }); atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:feel-neuro", { as: "b" })
hooks.bind("a/kick", atoms.a.kickRack)
hooks.bind("a/snare", atoms.a.snareRack)
hooks.bind("a/perc", atoms.a.percRack)
hooks.bind("a/hats", atoms.a.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("a/bass", atoms.a.bassRack)
hooks.bind("b/kick", atoms.b.kickRack)
hooks.bind("b/snare", atoms.b.snareRack)
hooks.bind("b/perc", atoms.b.percRack)
hooks.bind("b/hats", atoms.b.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("b/bass", atoms.b.bassRack)
a_kick: s(atoms.a.kick).velocity(atoms.a.kickVel).use("a/kick", { mode: "swap" }).tags("a")
a_snare: s(atoms.a.snare).velocity(atoms.a.snareVel).use("a/snare", { mode: "swap" }).tags("a")
a_perc: s(atoms.a.perc).velocity(atoms.a.percVel).use("a/perc", { mode: "swap" }).tags("a")
a_hats: s(atoms.a.hats).velocity(atoms.a.hatsVel).use("a/hats", { mode: "swap" }).tags("a")
a_bass: note(atoms.a.bass).velocity(atoms.a.bassVel).use("a/bass", { mode: "swap" }).tags("a")
b_kick: s(atoms.b.kick).velocity(atoms.b.kickVel).use("b/kick", { mode: "swap" }).tags("b")
b_snare: s(atoms.b.snare).velocity(atoms.b.snareVel).use("b/snare", { mode: "swap" }).tags("b")
b_perc: s(atoms.b.perc).velocity(atoms.b.percVel).use("b/perc", { mode: "swap" }).tags("b")
b_hats: s(atoms.b.hats).velocity(atoms.b.hatsVel).use("b/hats", { mode: "swap" }).tags("b")
b_bass: note(atoms.b.bass).velocity(atoms.b.bassVel).use("b/bass", { mode: "swap" }).tags("b")
sub: note(atoms.b.bass).hook("dnbSub").tags("b")   // multiband by layers: the neuro riff's notes on a mono sine sub
tagged("a").mute("@3b")
tagged("b").mute("<3b")
